title: 3 Equations of Motion Explained Simply | PUC Physics Class 11
description:
A ball thrown up, a car braking, a bicycle rolling down a slope. One set of three equations predicts all of them. Aarav starts from rest at the top of a slope and gains 2 m/s every second. Without riding, can he know his speed and distance after 5 seconds? In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Physics (NCERT Chapter 2, Motion in a Straight Line) we build the three equations of uniformly accelerated motion.

A live motion bench shows the bicycle, its growing velocity arrow, paint marks spaced 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 m apart and a live v-t graph. We derive v = v0 + at from the meaning of acceleration, x = v0t + 1/2 at^2 from the area under the v-t graph, and v^2 = v0^2 + 2ax by removing time, step by step. Then a rule for picking the right equation with a pause-and-think, Aarav's worked example, the exam trap, an original NEET pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, JEE Main and NEET students.

In this video:
0:00 Three moments, one set of equations
0:32 Five quantities, one condition
0:50 The bicycle on the motion bench
1:21 Equation 1: v = v0 + at
1:45 Equation 2: area under the v-t graph
2:11 Equation 3: when time is not given
2:33 Which equation? + pause and think
3:21 Worked example: Aarav after 5 s
3:53 Exam trap: constant acceleration only
4:20 Practice question (NEET pattern)
4:57 Recap and three questions to answer

Next episode: Motion under Gravity. Drop a stone and a feather where there is no air. Which lands first?
